summary: Round 2 over plan r3. Three of six seats succeeded (Claude, Codex, GLM); Qwen timed out and Gemini and Kimi returned malformed output. All three asked for revision. One concern reached two supporters: the IR1 draft spec at the reviewed commit still bound references during composition, against r3's repaired design. Divergent views: flat-model reference paths and file names in IR2, and the orphan fact_type_constraints class under R0.6.

agreed_concerns.title: The IR1 draft spec binds references during composition, against plan r3
agreed_concerns.summary: Plan r3 composes include roots without binding references and binds them at --reference-root (IR1-C8); the IR1 spec at the reviewed commit still called load_model_bytes_composed, which binds under the model directory.

prioritized_fixes.title: Compose without binding references in the IR1 spec
prioritized_fixes.action: Rewrite the IR1 spec's api.judgments and raw-subject loads to compose without binding references, then bind at --reference-root, and add IR1-C8 to its tests.

prioritized_fixes.title: State what a flat model's relative reference paths mean
prioritized_fixes.action: Say in IR2 that reference paths stay relative to the authored root's directory, fix IR2-C2 to write into that directory, and let the IR2 spec decide whether another DIR is refused.

prioritized_fixes.title: Define the composed-route predicate as declares_includes
prioritized_fixes.action: Scope R0.6 and IR1-C7 to documents with neither includes nor fact_type_constraints, and pin the orphan-attachment refusal moving from include:unsupported-route to include:declaration.

prioritized_fixes.title: Use the names gnd flatten writes
prioritized_fixes.action: Name the flat files by their stem-derived names, checking.orm.flat.orm.json and extraction.orm.flat.orm.json, or mark the H7 names probe-local.
